item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 18/Apr/2026
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Winds will be weak with relatively low visibility over the coast of Guangdong tomorrow. The weather will be hot during the day. Under the influence of upper-air disturbances and an easterly airstream, there will be a few showers over the coast of southern China on Monday and Tuesday. A trough of low pressure is expected to bring unsettled weather to southern China in the middle and latter parts of next week.
